verdict.rationale: Lambda documents launching instances programmatically through the Lambda Cloud API, and its REST endpoints are described as able to 'create and manage' resources. An unofficial community CLI/MCP server shows instances can be launched and terminated programmatically. Billing is hourly in one-minute increments, and support confirms that only running instances are billed, idle or not. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of programmatic stop/start and restart (reboot) operations, first-party documentation of the terminate endpoint, and a statement that stopped or terminated instances stop accruing charges.
